intendedObjective: Replace the recording sample rate and filename prefix with the supplied values.
acceptableEditScope: Only two replacements: 44.1 kHz to 48 kHz and AMBER to CEDAR.
stableFactsAndClaims: Each session folder contains the original recording and a separate captured-sounds text file.
Retain originals when preparing catalogue excerpts; excerpts have separate filenames and notes locating their start in the original.
Record microphone position before moving equipment because sound alone cannot recover it.
Mark failed takes in notes instead of silently removing them.
Do not apply noise reduction to raw files; label processed copies as processed.
requiredForm: Existing recording setup sheet with exactly two updates.
voiceConstraints: Preserve the existing direct technical instructions.

sourceObjectiveEvidence.quote: Replace the sample rate with 48 kHz and the filename prefix with CEDAR. Make only those two supplied updates to the setup sheet.
